project.name: Kovac townhouses, 18 Wattlebird Street
project.summary: Demolition of a 1958 single-storey brick house and construction of multi dwelling housing: one attached row of 4 two-storey, two-bedroom townhouses (460 m2 GFA in total, 115 m2 each, single garages off a common driveway) with community title subdivision into 4 lots and association property, on a 700 m2 R2 lot in Carlingford. One DA to the City of Parramatta, on-site detention required by council, traffic and waste reports, architect-led tender to residential builders under an HIA lump-sum contract; budget $1,650,000 ex GST.
